item.title: Issue #2944 created
item.description:
Editorial Notes (October 2026 edition)

  • [ ] Minor typos and fixes:

XQFO

  • fn:parse-html: The last example, parse-html("<p>Hi</p>", method:="html"), is obsolete.
  • HTML mapping, note on DocumentFragment: include-template-content and html-parser-options were dropped; remove the note.
  • fn:iri-to-uri ($iri → $value), fn:matching-segments ($regex → $pattern), fn:replace ($input → $value), fn:parse-csv, fn:csv-to-arrays ($csv → $value), fn:jkey, fn:jvalue ($node → $input), fn:element-to-map ($elements → $element, single node).
  • fn:unparsed-text(-lines), fallback option: “If $fallback is true”.
  • fn:normalize-space, notes: normalize-string → normalize-space.
  • fn:parse-json, number-format option (2×): <xtermref spec="XP40" ref="dt-datum"/>; the term is defined in F&O/XDM.
  • fn:json-to-xml, fallback example: '\u0000' etc. are no escapes in XPath string literals.
  • fn:jtree, rules: “two calls with equal input may return the same JNode” must not apply to XNodes; two distinct but deep-equal <a/> elements would share one JNode, and jvalue() would return the wrong one. “Equal” should mean identical (is for XNodes).
  • JNode intro (“Functions on JNodes”): “applying the function repeatedly to the same map or array” – maps have no identity (#2802); align with the wording in fn:jtree.
  • “be be followed” (fn:system-properties), “context context” (fn:default-collation), “is is an instance” (casting to xs:boolean).

XQuery

  • Note on keyword arguments: xml-to-json(indent := true()), parse-json(escape := false()); options are no parameters.
  • Lookup vs. path on records: fn:dateTime-record(2026, 4, 1); built-in record types have no constructor.
  • Function coercion example: trailing comma in { …, "Friday" : true(), }.
  • GNode comparisons: $A ? child::type(xs:integer) → $A/child::….
  • Computed PI constructors: let $target := "audio-output", return.
  • Computed namespace constructors: namespace #xmlns:xsi → #xsi.
  • Group by: group by collation-key(…) lacks a grouping variable; $product → $p.
  • “it is is a” (function types), “the following following expressions” (map types), “there there are” (string literals), “type type tests” (type tests), “and and all options” (option declaration), “in in this section” (serialization parameters).

XDM

  • “material labeled as as a note” (introduction).
  • JNodes, root identity: “every operation that constructs a root JNode returns a JNode with distinct identity” contradicts fn:jtree, which allows calls with equal input to return the same JNode. Proposal: “The identity of a root JNode is established when it is constructed. Whether repeated calls of fn:jtree with identical input return the same root JNode is implementation-dependent; see fn:jtree.”

Binary

  • bin:pad-left, bin:pad-right ($size → $count); “the length of of the resulting string” (bin:hex); ASN.1 example calls bin:int-octets, declared as asn:int-octets.
  • Unbalanced parentheses in the examples of bin:to-octets, bin:join, bin:find (4×).
  • <xspecref spec="XP40" ref="casting-to-string"/> → FO40; FO40#func-binary-resource does not exist (fn:unparsed-binary?).
